decisions.reason: As a newly launched 2024 automation product, it likely benefits from recent development investment and management will tend to continue backing it unless early weak uptake clearly persists beyond what can be blamed on a normal market ramp-up.

Although only mentioned on the website, the firm has still publicly introduced and invested in this 2024 loading system, which makes a near-term withdrawal relatively unlikely absent strong evidence of failure.

This product has the strongest visible commitment through its own page and a 2024 Red Dot award, so management is especially likely to justify and extend the launch rather than remove it within a year.
